faces.name: Evolutionary Escalation
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control and three +1/+1 counters on target creature an opponent controls.

faces.name: Evolutionary Leap
faces.oracleText: {G}, Sacrifice a creature: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

faces.name: Evolution Charm
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Target creature gains flying until end of turn.

faces.name: Evolution Sage
faces.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

faces.name: Evolution Vat
faces.oracleText: {3}, {T}: Tap target creature and put a +1/+1 counter on it. Until end of turn, that creature gains "{2}{G}{U}: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature."

faces.name: Evolution Witness
faces.oracleText:
{1}{G}: Adapt 2. (If this creature has no +1/+1 counters on it, put two +1/+1 counters on it.)
Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.

faces.name: Evolved Sleeper
faces.oracleText:
{B}: This creature becomes a Human Cleric with base power and toughness 2/2.
{1}{B}: If this creature is a Cleric, put a deathtouch counter on it and it becomes a Phyrexian Human Cleric with base power and toughness 3/3.
{1}{B}{B}: If this creature is a Phyrexian, put a +1/+1 counter on it, then you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

faces.name: Evolved Spinoderm
faces.oracleText:
This creature enters with four oil counters on it.
This creature has trample as long as it has two or fewer oil counters on it. Otherwise, it has hexproof.
At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from this creature. Then if it has no oil counters on it, sacrifice it.
